title: Design System: Agentic Runtime Platform Dashboard

mono.purpose: Run ids, step names, logs, JSON.

micro.purpose: Type floor: labels, IDs, timestamps, tags (11/15).

motion.name: motion-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, focus and button feedback; the cap for color/opacity transitions under reduced motion.

motion.name: motion-slow
motion.purpose: Drawer and sheet entry, graph layout settle.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Stop every loop, snap transform and size changes, keep paint-only feedback capped at 120ms.

components.name: Status marker
components.description: The one status vocabulary: icon + sentence-case word + semantic color.
components.html: Failed
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font: 500 12px/16px 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status--failed { color: #a33228; } .ds-status--success { color: #236c4b; } .ds-status--running { color: #2f6788; }

components.name: Focus ring
components.description: 2px --el-focus outline with 2px offset on :focus-visible; inset variant for rows and tabs.
components.css: .ds-focus { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #857f73; border-radius: 4px; background: #f8f5ef; color: #1b1b18; } .ds-focus:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9e321c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Scoreline
components.description: Ruled metric band that replaces KPI cards; em dash for no data.
components.css: .ds-scoreline { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(140px, 1fr)); border-top: 1px solid #bdb7aa; border-bottom: 1px solid #bdb7aa; margin: 0; } .ds-scoreline div { padding: 16px 0; } .ds-scoreline div + div { border-left: 1px solid #d3cec4; padding-left: 16px; } .ds-scoreline dt { font: 400 12px/16px system-ui, sans-serif; color: #5a554c; } .ds-scoreline dd { margin: 4px 0 0; font: 500 28px/1 Georgia, serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #1b1b18; }

narrative.overview: Each run is an auditable record: warm paper surfaces, near-black ink, hairline dividers instead of shadows, and one scarce vermilion accent.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper neutrals, never pure white or pure black.
One scarce vermilion accent; status uses its own semantic hues.
Hairline borders over shadows; small radii.
Tokens are RGB triplets so opacity modifiers work.

rules.name: The One Mark Rule
rules.body: Vermilion marks the thing the operator should look at now. It never decorates.

rules.name: The Triplet Rule
rules.body: Define colors as RGB triplets under --el-*; never use legacy --b-* aliases in new code.

rules.name: The Machine Text Rule
rules.body: Run ids, step names, logs and JSON are always mono.

rules.name: The Flat-Ledger Rule
rules.body: Cards and panels never carry shadows; only popovers/overlays do.

rules.name: The Floor Rule
rules.body: No essential text below 11px, no text tier below 4.5:1, no control boundary below 3:1, no focus indicator below a solid 2px ring.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Vermilion marks one thing per view: the selection rail, a key mark, or the primary emphasis. Accent text and state rails use accent-strong.

rules.name: The Honest State Rule
rules.body: One shell banner for an unreachable API; em dashes for absent data; disabled actions say why; CLI equivalents only when real.

dos: Do use el-* or shadcn semantic tokens and keep the paper theme as default.
Do separate regions with 1px dividers and tonal steps.
Do keep vermilion to ≤ one emphasis per view.
Do use the Scoreline for metrics.
Do use StatusBadge for every status.
Do use focus-ring on custom controls.
donts: Don't add new code against the legacy --b-* aliases.
Don't use pure #fff/#000 or drop shadows on panels.
Don't convey status by color alone; pair with a label or icon.
Don't use eyebrows above headings or decorative section numbers.
Don't use monospace as a costume.
Don't animate layout properties or use transition-all.
